definitions.timing_principle: Natal promise + running dasa/bhukti decides results; transit only triggers. Transit without supporting dasa gives little (like electricity with no appliances).
definitions.karako_bhava_nashti: A karaka in its own signified house can harm that house - Venus in 7th is the classic case, but with many exceptions below.

venus_strength_rules.result: Financially well above self-sufficiency; may be generous or miserly but will be wealthy

venus_strength_rules.condition: Venus conjoined with a planet that becomes own-sign through sign exchange (parivartana)
Venus alone AND its dispositor exalted

venus_strength_rules.result: Success comes late, after many challenges
Still succeeds financially; strongly goal-driven and may compromise on ethics to win

venus_strength_rules.condition: Venus in own/exalted sign, kendra/trikona, or with own/exalted planet
Venus retrograde AND with Rahu or Ketu

venus_strength_rules.result: Displays wealth openly - branded goods, showy house, visible jewellery; may look richer than they are
Conceals wealth - jewellery kept hidden or unused
Strong: outward polish and visible comfort. Weak/hidden: looks ordinary even if owning assets

venus_7th_rules.name: Karako bhava nashti cancelled
condition_any: Venus in 7th in own/exalted sign (Mesha, Viruchigam or Kanni lagna)
Jupiter aspects or conjoins Venus in 7th
venus_7th_rules.result: No harm; Venus in 7th works as a yoga.

condition_any: lagna lord aspects or conjoins Venus in 7th
lord_5 or lord_9 aspects or conjoins Venus in 7th
venus_7th_rules.result: Karako bhava nashti neutralised (neutral, not necessarily a big yoga).

venus_7th_rules.name: Venus in 7th - general results
results: Myth rejected: does NOT by itself mean multiple marriages or poor character
Attractive spouse with a pleasant smile; spouse of one's liking
Turning point and rise in life after marriage - more income, assets, jewellery, vehicles after marriage than before
Partnership business does well, especially with women partners
Female native: lives far more comfortably after marriage than in parental home
Loves travel, usually together with spouse; affectionate towards spouse and children
Female native: likely owns imitation jewellery; fond of fashion and dressing up
Business may attract professional jealousy and hidden opposition

venus_7th_rules.name: Venus with Mars in 7th
venus_7th_rules.result: Not a dara dosha by default. Marital turbulence only if Mars or Venus dasa runs within the first 2-3 years of marriage; later dasas don't harm.

condition_any: Venus in a Mars sign with Mars strong elsewhere
venus_7th_rules.result: Spouse brings property, jewellery and money from their family; marked upward mobility after marriage (e.g. vehicle comfort).
Spouse has strong administrative ability and manages/saves money well; spectacles likely.

venus_7th_rules.condition: Venus with Jupiter in 7th (or in Lagna)
venus_7th_rules.result: Very fortunate marriage; excellent spouse; life lifts to a more refined standard after marriage.
venus_7th_rules.exceptions: Fails if Jupiter or Venus retrograde, dispositor debilitated, or Rahu/Ketu involved.

results: Still gives income and assets, but may split resources outside the household
Emotionally soft towards women relatives (sisters, spouse's sisters) - may lose money through sympathy
Used vehicles suit better than new ones
venus_7th_rules.contrast: Strong non-retrograde Venus in 7th: travel that earns; at least one family vacation a year.

venus_7th_rules.condition: Venus in 7th not retrograde BUT lord_7 debilitated or retrograde
venus_7th_rules.result: Marriage talks reach final stage and then break off, repeatedly, before finally settling.

venus_7th_rules.condition: Venus in 7th AND Venus dasa during peak earning years

modifiers.with_rahu: Higher vulnerability to romantic manipulation / scams - advise caution
modifiers.with_ketu: Very reserved and shy around the opposite sex

venus_7th_rules.result: Deep affection, but after quarrels both wait for the other to make up first (pride).

qa_rules.condition: Venus conjunct Mercury (esp. Mercury own sign)
qa_rules.result: Good for business in women's products, attractive goods, computer/internet gadgets; startups do well, especially away from home.

qa_rules.principle: Same retrograde own-sign Venus gives opposite results for different lagnas - always judge by house lordship.

examples.placement: Venus retro in own sign in 6th
examples.result: Yoga - own business if lord_10 strong; else high post in private firm

examples.placement: Venus retro in own sign in 2nd
Venus retro in own sign in 11th
Venus retro in own sign in 10th

qa_rules.condition: Simha lagna, Venus own sign in 10th, aspected by retrograde Saturn
qa_rules.result: Own business succeeds in Venus dasa; reassess in other dasas.

qa_rules.condition: Saturn dasa running AND the planet ruling the 7th sign from Saturn is in own sign
More than one planet in house 11 (e.g. Venus, Mars, Ketu)
qa_rules.result: Strong financial success; even stronger if lord_11 is own sign in 11.
Good marital life even with Mars/Saturn/Mercury/Rahu there; quarrels limited to in-law topics.

qa_rules.principle: Writing talent is from the Moon (imagination); Mercury is only the pen and paper.

qa_rules.result: Myth rejected: a planet in Sathayam nakshatra is NOT inactive.
qa_rules.example: Venus (2nd & 9th lord) in 6th for Kanni lagna in Sathayam - some financial/study/family/health (eyes, stomach) disturbance, otherwise fine.

qa_rules.result: Father's health disturbed only during Mars mahadasa.
